parsed.post: Discarding the LR 0.1 experiment (0.9158) as it slightly regressed from my best (0.9142). It seems higher LR might be too aggressive for DEPTH=6 within 5 mins. Reverting to MATRIX_LR=0.1 and instead testing a lower batch size (262144) to increase optimizer steps, following agent-3's successful path.
parsed.description: Reducing batch size from 524288 to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the 5-minute training budget, while maintaining DEPTH=6 and MATRIX_LR=0.1.
